retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, two-tone diagonal split layout featuring heavy italicized sans-serif typography and a monochromatic portrait.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist white space is required
soft pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A graphic composition divided by a sharp diagonal line separating a warm orange field from a vibrant red field, featuring massive, black, slanted sans-serif text that spans across the divide, paired with a monochromatic portrait integrated into the red section.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal background split creates dynamic tension
Typography scales down progressively to fit the diagonal wedge
Portrait color matches the background field for a integrated duotone effect
Black text provides high contrast against both warm background tones
coreInvariants: Sharp diagonal division between two primary warm colors
Monochromatic portrait integrated into the right-hand color field

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The portrait is positioned in the lower right quadrant, scaled to occupy approximately one-third of the total width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold text in the upper left serves as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal split from top-right to bottom-left, guided by the descending lines of text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the composition is densely packed with type and imagery.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red field on the right.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation, medium value warm tones with flat, matte application.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, geometric sans-serif with a strong italic slant.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair heavy display sans-serif with a small, light serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century American sans-serif aesthetic and weight.
Provides the necessary vertical presence and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square canvas divided by a diagonal line from the top right to the bottom left. The left side is a flat orange-yellow and the right side is a flat red. Place a monochromatic red-toned portrait of a man in the lower right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, black, heavy italicized sans-serif text in all caps. Align the text to the left, ensuring it crosses the diagonal boundary.

verificationChecks: Is the text heavy, black, and italicized?
Is the portrait monochromatic and integrated into the red field?
Does the text cross the color boundary?

mustAchieve: High contrast between text and background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the diagonal line is sharp and clean.
Ensure the text weight is sufficiently heavy.
Verify the portrait is monochromatic red.
Confirm the text is all-caps and italicized.
recipe.reuseFormula: Diagonal split + Heavy Italic Sans + Monochromatic Portrait = Mid-Century Dynamic Layout
